ranked.headline: Learned models of sequence and structure drive generative biomolecule design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair protein language models and structure predictors with generative design, benchmarking, and new ML-ready datasets.

ranked.headline: Graph and transformer models infer gene regulatory networks from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair single-cell foundation models and graph architectures with regulatory network benchmarks and perturbation data.

ranked.headline: Testing whether EEG and neural biomarkers generalize across cohorts and populations
ranked.summary: Resting-EEG and TMS biomarker studies report accuracy losses outside development cohorts, motivating explicit cross-population evaluation.

ranked.headline: Persistent homology, neural ODEs, and twin models probe brain structure and dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend quantitative genetics, topological morphometry, and longitudinal modeling to brain MRI and PET data across the lifespan.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks test whether molecular models transfer beyond their training distributions
ranked.summary: New preprints test whether model scale, benchmark splits, and conformal methods hold up under distribution shift in molecular prediction.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies in fungi, algae and plants resolve genome architecture
ranked.summary: Haplotype-phased and chromosome-level references for poplar rust, duckweed, red alga, wild rice, and two other flowering plants are newly reported.

ranked.headline: Computational tools target individual noisy steps in single-cell and spatial profiling
ranked.summary: Foundation models and digital twins now enable in silico perturbation, while stage-specific noise correction addresses single-cell data artifacts.

ranked.headline: Learned fusion of omics, histology and clinical data for cancer and biomarker tasks
ranked.summary: Multimodal integration of omics, histology and clinical data is being advanced by confidence-aware, contrastive and optimal-transport fusion methods.

ranked.headline: Weakly and semi-supervised deep learning for biomedical microscopy and MRI images
ranked.summary: Label-efficient and lightweight attention architectures are being applied to MRI, histopathology, organoid, and fluorescence microscopy image analysis.

ranked.headline: Protein language models and gene-order transformers advance bacterial genomic inference
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published study apply protein language models, transformers, and large genome resources to microbial and viral sequence inference.

ranked.headline: Models link regulatory noise and network structure to emergent biological dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication extend classical regulatory and neural dynamics models with noise, spatial structure, and weighted connectivity.

ranked.headline: Learned models steer lead optimization, molecular generation, and protein-ligand docking
ranked.summary: Three recent published studies pair learned chemical reasoning, reaction-aware transformers, and geometric flows with design and docking tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks of inference tools on ancient genomes test selection and imputation accuracy
ranked.summary: Inference tools are now benchmarked on ancient and historical genomes, testing selection and imputation directly in those populations.

ranked.headline: Molecular dynamics resolves lipid, ion, and drug effects on membrane protein mechanisms
ranked.summary: Recent MD studies of VDAC, aquaporin, and Kv2 channels resolve how lipids, water, and ligands alter membrane protein function at molecular detail.

ranked.headline: Single-cell perturbation models are being tested for transfer and scientific value
ranked.summary: Benchmarks for virtual cell perturbation models are now being built to test unseen contexts and scientific value, not only prediction accuracy.

ranked.headline: Explicit physical models guide sampling and scoring of protein binding interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair MD trajectories, coarse-grained force fields and FEP with pharmacophore and fragment-orbital analysis of binding.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models link cell phenotype, adhesion and drug effects to spatial patterns
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply ODE and spatial simulation models to how phenotype, adhesion and drug effects shape tumour spatial organization.

ranked.headline: Open-source pipelines for taxonomic, metagenomic, and phylogenomic sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication present open-source workflows for Sanger, metagenomic, and long-read viral sequence analysis with explicit validation.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings drive sequence-based prediction of protein interactions and kinetics
ranked.summary: Pretrained sequence and structure representations now feed interaction, kinetic, and folding predictions with out-of-distribution generalization as a central…

ranked.headline: Bayesian inference of nucleic acid motif rate parameters from count-based reactor data
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 work pairs uncertainty-aware inference for RNA reactor motif kinetics with heterogeneity-aware phylogenomic and gene-transfer modeling.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools for structure-aware, phylogenetic, and simulated genomic analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases add structure-aware alignment subsetting, mixture-model phylogenetics, and missing-data VCF simulation for benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models applied to microbiome, viral genomic, and immune repertoire data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply tree ensembles, sparse classifiers, and AI-based matching to microbiome and immune-sequence classification tasks.

ranked.headline: Phenotypic and omic clocks quantify biological aging trajectories
ranked.summary: Longitudinal and multi-omic data now enable per-individual biological age estimates tracked along aging and developmental trajectories.

ranked.headline: Physically constrained models of noninvasive human brain dynamics from EEG, MEG, fMRI
ranked.summary: Noninvasive EEG, MEG and fMRI recordings are now paired with dynamic and geometric constraints to infer principles of neural control.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and conservation models map RNA-binding and regulatory sites genome-wide
ranked.summary: Conservation-aware deep learning now predicts cross-species RBP-RNA binding, while genome-wide annotation resolves RNA regulatory elements in the human genome.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale software now predicts microbial metabolic potential and community design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce pipelines, benchmarks, and language models that standardize genome-based inference of microbial taxonomy, function,…

ranked.headline: Machine learning and network models prioritize drug and ligand candidates
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph learning, network medicine, and zinc-binding chemotype analysis with target-aware ligand generation.

ranked.headline: Graphical and web-based tools now package omics analysis into guided, reusable workflows
ranked.summary: Public omics datasets and deep mutational scanning data now come with graphical, browsable tools for reanalysis and workflow assembly.

ranked.headline: Cross-platform benchmarks reveal spatial transcriptomics specificity and noise limits
ranked.summary: Matched multi-platform datasets and purification methods now enable direct, quantitative comparison of imaging-based spatial transcriptomics platforms.

ranked.headline: Chromatin architecture across scales shapes regulatory output
ranked.summary: Long-read, Micro-C and low-depth methods now resolve chromatin structure from single fibres to kilobase compartments and multiway contacts.

ranked.headline: Local DNA dosage and reference context shape the accuracy of sequencing-based readouts
ranked.summary: Sequencing readouts depend on reference context, and new controls and benchmarks now test that dependence across ATAC-seq and methylation assays.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models extend ab initio gene prediction and protein function annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2026 publication report deep-learning tools for eukaryotic annotation, protein function and metagenomic binning.

ranked.headline: Network and enrichment logic applied to differential omics across disease contexts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend differential network and enrichment analysis to microbial, metabolomic, germline and somatic data.

ranked.headline: Simulations map conformational dynamics of membrane-associated proteins and kinases
ranked.summary: Recent MD studies tie lipid-membrane context and oligomerization to conformational states of four distinct membrane-associated protein systems.

ranked.headline: Computational probes of protein conformational plasticity and structural fragility
ranked.summary: Predicted structures are increasingly interrogated for fragility, plasticity, and allosteric coupling rather than treated as static models.

ranked.headline: In silico tools score primers, ligands, and base editor guides before bench work
ranked.summary: Reproducible open-source pipelines now report explicit intermediate criteria such as strand checks, ligand efficiency, and off-target annotation.

ranked.headline: Learning stochastic gene regulation and branching dynamics from snapshot and…
ranked.summary: Scalable inference of stochastic gene-regulatory and birth-death dynamics is now being fit directly to single-cell and calcium measurements.

ranked.headline: DIA proteomics software gains ion-level missing-value recovery and benchmarked resources
ranked.summary: Recent tools and resources target DIA quantification, DIA-NN output assessment, and benchmarked cancer MS protein references.

ranked.headline: Generative models design proteins and peptides with custom folds and reduced alphabets
ranked.summary: Generative AI now redesigns essential E. coli proteins without isoleucine, yielding a viable 19-amino acid-alphabet cell.

ranked.headline: Predicted protein structure is becoming a direct readout for missense variant effect
ranked.summary: Predicted structure is now applied to reclassifying USH2A VUS and selecting exon-skipping targets, beyond serving only as model input.
